intro.text: A servant at Mercystar's palace in T'Telir.

items.text: When Vasher breaks into the palace and throws his sheathed sword at Lolan and three other servants, Lolan picks it up, thinking to use it against the intruder. Vasher knocks him out while the sword has his attention.
Questioned by Lightsong, Lolan is reluctant to show his hurt hand, which turned grey once he started to draw the sword. After talking with Lightsong he is remorseful.
